How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 5.17-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Hand-painted 2D anime cel animation: clean confident linework, flat cel shading with soft painted backgrounds, rich pink and teal neon light, steady diagonal rain and wet reflective rooftops at night. The courier girl has a short black bob, a bright yellow raincoat with the hood down and a dark green messenger bag; the three ninjas wear all black with red scarves over their faces. Characters keep the same proportions, outlines and colors in every frame. The shot begins exactly on Picture 1. At about half a second the girl sprints to the stairwell hut and slips through the red door just before the ninjas can drop on her. At about one and a half seconds she races up a dark concrete stairwell lit by flickering red light. At about three seconds she bursts out of a door onto a narrow steel catwalk in front of a giant glowing billboard and drops into a crouch. The shot settles into the final composition of Picture 2 and holds: the girl crouched on the catwalk seen from behind, the giant glowing pink and blue billboard, the elevated train passing below on the right, the red and white antenna on the left, and the three ninjas standing at the far left end of the catwalk.

overall_soundscape: Heavy rain, splashing footsteps, a metal door slamming, fast footsteps echoing up concrete stairs, a door banging open, rain on steel grating.

non_diegetic_music: None.
